claim.claim-text: 2. The system of claim 1, wherein the signal degradation data includes values for free space losses of the at least one signal.
3. The system of claim 1, further comprising an optimization module configured to provide signal optimization parameters.
4. The system of claim 3, wherein the optimization module is configured to provide the signal optimization parameters for center frequency, bandwidth, and/or power.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one device is configured to compare the data relating to the at least one signal with stored data.
6. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one device is configured to identify the at least one signal in real-time or near real-time.

7. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one device is configured to perform the pattern distortion, generate the propagation models, and generate the next neighbor interference models using the signal degradation data and measured terrain data of geographic locations.
9. The apparatus of claim 8, wherein the signal degradation data includes values for free space losses of the at least one signal.
10. The apparatus of claim 8, further comprising an optimization module configured to provide signal optimization parameters.
11. The apparatus of claim 10, wherein the optimization module is configured to provide the signal optimization parameters for center frequency, bandwidth, and/or power.
12. The apparatus of claim 8, wherein the at least one device is configured to compare data for the at least one signal with stored data.
13. The apparatus of claim 8, wherein the at least one device is configured to identify the at least one signal in real-time or near real-time.
15. The method of claim 14, wherein the signal degradation data includes values for free space losses of the at least one signal.
16. The method of claim 14, further comprising an optimization module providing signal optimization parameters.
17. The method of claim 16, further comprising providing by the optimization module, the signal optimization parameters for center frequency, bandwidth, and/or power.

18. The method of claim 14, wherein the signal degradation data is further based on hardware parameters, wherein the hardware parameters comprise antenna type, orientation, azimuth, gain, and/or effective isotropic radiated power (EIRP).
19. The method of claim 14, further comprising comparing by the at least one device, data relating to the at least one signal with stored data.
20. The method of claim 14, wherein the RF data includes a location from which the at least one second device is emitting the at least one signal.
